preamble.summary: Within-run check: for the seven algorithms of the follow-ups, the second-best final configuration of the same irace run (control_2026_10_continuous_bounce). Compared with the best one it shows how much two good configurations of one tuning run differ on the study's instances. Run with EXPERIMENT_CONTROL_SET.

procedure.derived_from: control_2026_10_continuous_bounce: elites[1] of each block listed under algorithms, unchanged
procedure.change: the fixed settings of the block's params (constraint_handling_mode = bounce where the algorithm takes it) copied into the elite, so the boundary rule matches the first elite
procedure.values_tuned_on: the 36 continuous instances of tuning set diverse-v2 (via control_2026_10_continuous_bounce) - NOT on any subset problem

preamble.selection: params = the second final elite (irace lists the final elites best first)

fixed_settings.why: a setting no tuning run raced, written into every algorithm that takes it
